name: openhands
description: OpenHands CLI as a background coding agent and agent harness, pointed at LOKI's local Ollama model by default (LLM_MODEL=openai/<model>, LLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1). Runs headless: openhands --headless --json -t <task>. The standalone CLI is no longer actively maintained, but works.
install: python tools/setup_extras.py openhands   (uv tool install openhands --python 3.12)
